baseline.depth_spread_note: robust standard deviation (median absolute deviation x 1.4826) of the per-chromosome depth ratio across autosomes -- the precision floor the five-model depth term is judged against

constants.note: centre and rho are fitted once on the pooled autosomal p and q arms and held fixed for every chromosome; centromeric rows, X and Y are excluded from that pool because neither describes a balanced autosome arm.
